exchanges: Okay so I have about twenty minutes before my next call and I just need to talk to something that isn't a four year old asking for juice.
Happy to help. How is the day going so far?
Honestly, a lot. I run the support team at Telus from my kitchen table, and today the phones are melting because of some outage.
Outage days are brutal. Is your team holding up?
They're fine, they're pros. It's me who is frazzled because Kojo has been up since five.
Early starts make everything harder.
My Samsung died halfway through the morning call too, so that was fun, had to finish it on the laptop.
Bad timing for a dead phone.
Elodie keeps telling me to get a new one. She's at the Ubisoft office today, they make them come in twice a week now.
Hybrid schedules seem to be everywhere now.
Yeah. She's heading to Montreal next month for some big game launch thing, five days, so I'll be solo parenting.
Five days solo with two little ones is a lot. Do you have backup?
My mum Ruth will probably help out. Although she has her heart doctor on Thursday that week so not that day.
Good that you know in advance.
She's fine, it's just a check-up, but she worries.
That is natural at any age.
My nephew Kai is staying with her right now, he's in his second year of engineering at the university nearby and she loves having him around.
That sounds like a good arrangement for both of them.
It is. He fixes her computer and she feeds him, fair trade.
A very fair trade.
Funny thing is there's also a Kai on my team, who's doing an accounting diploma at night school, so whenever someone says Kai I have to ask which one.
Two Kais would get confusing.
Very. Hold on, Ama is trying to climb the bookshelf.
Go, safety first.
Okay she's down. Crisis averted.
Glad everyone is in one piece.
I put on some Sade to calm everyone down. Works on the kids, works on me.
Good choice for calming a house down.
Sade was on every Sunday when I was a kid. We're Ghanaian, so it was Sade and highlife all weekend.
That sounds like a lovely way to grow up.
It was. Different question, do you know if beagles are okay with toddlers? Hamid next door just got a beagle and the kids are obsessed.
They are usually friendly and patient, though they can be loud.
Good to know. The kids have already named it in their heads.
Kids do that.
I've had to give up cheese and milk, by the way, the doctor thinks dairy is why my stomach's been off.
That is a tough change. How are you finding it?
Oat milk is fine. Cheese is the real loss.
Cheese is a hard one to give up.
Oh, I was wrong about Hamid's dog, it's a basset, not a beagle. He corrected me over the fence just now, very offended.
Even better, they are known for being gentle.
Ha, yes, he takes it seriously.
People are proud of their dogs.
Next call in five. Kojo is watching trucks on YouTube.
Trucks will buy you some time.
Hopefully thirty minutes of it.
Fingers crossed.
Mum just texted, she's finally selling the big house and staying put in her flat in Brampton.
That sounds like a good move for her.
Sorry, what's my nephew studying again?
Okay, call time. Wish me luck.
Good luck, you have got this.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your nephew Kai is in his second year of engineering.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your nephew Kai is studying accounting.
